# GxPHistorian

> GxPHistorian is a 21 CFR Part 11, EU GMP Annex 11, and ISPE GAMP 5 (2nd Ed.) qualified 4-Pillar open-source industrial time-series historian and ISA-95 Asset Framework powered by ClickHouse 24.8 LTS and PostgreSQL 16. It replaces proprietary OSIsoft / AVEVA PI System per-tag and per-seat licensing for regulated biopharma, cell & gene therapy, and cGMP manufacturing facilities.

- Canonical Site: https://gxphistorian.com/
- Documentation Portal: https://gxphistorian.com/docs/
- Executed 8-Document GMP Validation Binder (HTML): https://gxphistorian.com/binder/COMPLETE_GMP_VALIDATION_BINDER.html
- GitHub Repository (MIT Open-Core): https://github.com/saram-io/gxp-historian
- Commercial Implementation & Validation Services: https://saram.io/#inquiry

## 4-Pillar System Architecture

1. **Pillar 1 (`edge-collector`):** InfluxData Telegraf 1.32 + Python 3.12 `execd` workers normalizing 10 industrial protocols (OPC UA `:4840`, Classic Windows OPC DA 2.05a Zero-DCOM bridge, BACnet/IP `:47808 COV` & MS/TP, Siemens S7comm `:102`, EtherNet/IP CIP `:44818`, Modbus TCP `:502` & RTU RS-485, 4–20 mA HART, RS-232 MT-SICS balances, and ALCOA+ SHA-256 SMB Watch-Folders) with Stage 1 Exception/Deadband (`ExcDev`/`ExcMax`), optional Stage 2 Swinging Door (`CompDev`/`CompMax`), and a 1,000,000-sample disk-backed Store-and-Forward WAL (`>14-day` Level 2.5 OT autonomy).
2. **Pillar 2 (`clickhouse-archive`):** ClickHouse Server 24.8 LTS (`pi_historian.sensor_data`) using 100% mathematically lossless `DoubleDelta`, `Gorilla`, and `T64` + `ZSTD(1)` compression (1.5–2.5 bytes/sample), real-time 1-minute `AggregatingMergeTree` rollups filtered strictly on Good OPC quality (`WHERE quality >= 192`), and `largestTriangleThreeBuckets` (LTTB) peak-preserving visual downsampling.
3. **Pillar 3 (`postgres-control` + `historian-api`):** PostgreSQL 16 (`ltree` + `pgcrypto`) and FastAPI serving the ISA-95 Asset Hierarchy, GxP Tag Catalog, ISA-88 Event Frames (`TrueFor` historical backfill, parent/child batch phases, multi-stage §11.200 electronic signatures), GxP Calculation Engine (ICH Q1A `MKT`, USP `<1229>` $F_0$ steam lethality, Western Electric `SQC`), Multi-Channel PI Notifications (Email, SMS, Mobile Push, Escalation Teams, Two-Way SMS ACK), Pydantic AI Co-Pilot & `gxphistorian-mcp` FastMCP server, and kernel-level PL/pgSQL WORM SHA-256 hash-chain audit triggers across all 10 GxP state tables.
4. **Pillar 4 (`grafana-vision` + Excel DataLink + Lakehouse):** Pre-provisioned Grafana OSS 11.2 Bioreactor & Cleanroom Operator HMI (`gxphistorian-gxp-bioreactor-hmi`) with Event Frame & Golden Batch (`mean ± 2 SD`) overlays, 8 drop-in Excel DataLink UDFs (`=GXPHISTORIAN_CURRENT_VALUE`, `=GXPHISTORIAN_ARCHIVE_VALUE`, `=GXPHISTORIAN_COMPRESSED_DATA`, `=GXPHISTORIAN_SAMPLED`, `=GXPHISTORIAN_CALCULATED_DATA`, `=GXPHISTORIAN_TIME_FILTER`, `=GXPHISTORIAN_PLOT_VALUES`, `=GXPHISTORIAN_EVENT_SUMMARY`) + StreamSets & zero-macro Power Query CSV streams, and Zero-ETL Snappy Apache Parquet exports.

## Commercial Cloud & Edge SKUs (Unlimited HMI & Excel Users — $0 Per-Seat Tax)

- `GXP-CLOUD-LAB-2K5`: $18,000/yr — Up to 2,500 tags, 1 site, Managed Single-Tenant Cloud (`Pattern B`).
- `GXP-CLOUD-CLINICAL-25K`: $54,000/yr — Up to 25,000 tags, 2 redundant Edge IPCs, Multi-AZ Managed VPC (`Pattern B`), Okta/Entra §11.200 SSO, signed EU GMP Annex 11 §4.3 Quality Technical Agreement (QTA), and version-pinned `2026.Q4-LTS` Change Control channels.
- `GXP-CLOUD-BYOC-100K`: $150,000/yr — Up to 100,000 tags across 3 sites, deployed inside Customer's AWS/Azure/GCP VPC via Cloud Marketplace (`Pattern B & C`), 100% eligible for AWS EDP / Azure MACC / GCP Commit drawdown, with Customer-Managed KMS keys (`CMK`/`CMEK`).
- `GXP-EDGE-BOX-L25`: $3,500 hardware + $2,500/yr Fleet Care — Pre-flashed Advantech UNO-2484G / OnLogic Karbon 800 DIN-rail IPC with 100 GB pSLC NVMe Disk WAL and factory FAT/IQ certificate.
